build: Official economy and Edge of Fate reward records
observations: Nightfall weapons use a knockout list until the declared set is unlocked, then use flat drop chances.
Activity grade changes reward tier and Prime Engram chance.
Material sources, purchase paths, stack caps, and intended anti-hoarding behavior have been documented.
Removed currencies caused related focusing costs and obsolete material handling to change.
inferences: Reward probability, collection breadth, power progression, and currency value are separate states that should not be compressed into one rarity label.
Economy retirement must update inventories, costs, interfaces, and explanations together.
limits: Official posts state rules but do not publish full probability telemetry or player-retention causality.
Later live-service updates can supersede these bounded observations.
